title: EU authorities include HTX exchange in Russian sanctions

title: Saudi Arabia-Bound Supertanker U-Turns Before Houthi Chokepoint
summary: A Hong Kong-flagged supertanker bound for Saudi Arabia’s Red Sea port of Yanbu has U-turned just before reaching the Bab el-Mandeb chokepoint, where recent attacks were launched by the Houthis as part of a blockade on ships linked to the kingdom.

title: Bordeaux Suburbs at Risk as 200,000 Flee Fires in France, Spain
summary: More than 200,000 people fled towns in central Spain and southern France overnight as uncontrolled wildfires moved ever closer to the cities of Madrid and Bordeaux.
